compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Allocated process-burden proxy, not a physical mass/energy conversion or delivered metal purchase. All nominal source technosphere and biosphere coefficients are proportional to the same source main-product inventory. Apply that audited allocation-equivalent kg per MJ to the corresponding complete native process exactly once, preserving signed caller heat demand, uncertainty and formulas. Native technology, geography, vintage, allocation and internal uncertainty replace source assumptions; score differences remain unquantified. No gas boiler, district network, extra heat-loss multiplier, efficiency normalization, steel recovery credit or avoided process is added. No assumption of identical supplier/reference uncertainty correlation is made. Source and target references are positive; only exact ecoinvent3.9cutoff profiles qualify. Other releases, reverse and cross-system-model routes remain unapproved. Native European scrap-based electric-arc steelmaking and casting replaces Austrian/rest-of-world low-alloyed reinforcing-billet production. Native un-/low-alloyed product scope, alloy mix, scrap inputs and allocation differ. Do not substitute a converter, mixed-steel market, reinforcing product including rolling, or worst-plant inventory.
